summary: Delphi VCL desktop application rendering a 2D animated ski jump sequence with procedural graphics, frame-based animation, and a resolution-independent coordinate system.
key_features: Frame-based animation engine (~25 FPS via TTimer)
Multi-stage automated ski jump sequence (5 phases)
Interactive debug mode with coordinate measurement & clipboard export
Modular architecture with separated rendering, audio, and logic units
achievements: Engineered a resolution-independent normalized coordinate system to decouple logical positioning from screen dimensions. Designed a phase-driven animation pipeline synchronizing camera movement, procedural particle systems, and frame sequencing. Implemented non-intrusive real-time debugging tools (coordinate measurement, mouse panning) while maintaining a stable 25 FPS render loop. Structured the codebase into dedicated units following separation of concerns, ensuring maintainability and clear module boundaries.
